byrne:1847.author: Oliver Byrne
byrne:1847.work: The First Six Books of the Elements of Euclid in Which Coloured Diagrams and Symbols Are Used Instead of Letters for the Greater Ease of Learners
byrne:1847.locus: London: William Pickering (printed by Charles Whittingham, Chiswick Press), 1847

simson:1756.author: Robert Simson
simson:1756.work: The Elements of Euclid, viz. the First Six Books, together with the Eleventh and Twelfth
simson:1756.note: Source of Byrne's English wording and his numbering of 35 Definitions, 3 Postulates, and 12 Axioms.

horace:ars.author: Horace
horace:ars.note: Quoted by Byrne in the 1847 Introduction (p. viii) on the vividness of ocular demonstration.

heath:1908.author: Sir Thomas Little Heath
heath:1908.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements

proclus:friedlein.author: Proclus Diadochus
proclus:friedlein.work: In Primum Euclidis Elementorum Librum Commentarii
proclus:friedlein.locus: ed. G. Friedlein, Teubner, 1873; trans. G. R. Morrow, Princeton, 1970
proclus:friedlein.note: Defines the six formal divisions of a Euclidean proposition (geometor/proclus).

hoenen:1954.author: P. H. J. Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen:1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen:1954.note: Epistemological analysis of judgment from spatial phantasmata (geometor/hoenen).

demorgan:1872.author: Augustus De Morgan
demorgan:1872.note: Records Victorian mathematical skepticism toward Byrne's chromatic pedagogy.

mclean:1963.author: Ruari McLean
mclean:1963.work: Victorian Book Design and Colour Printing
mclean:1963.note: Landmark bibliographic study of Chiswick Press relief color registration in Byrne's 1847 Euclid.

tufte:1990.author: Edward R. Tufte
tufte:1990.note: Analyzes Byrne's inline color glyphs as direct visual nouns that eliminate label-lookup indirection.

hawcock:2010.author: Werner Oechslin (intro.)
hawcock:2010.work: Oliver Byrne: Six Books of Euclid (Facsimile Edition)
hawcock:2010.note: Modern photographic facsimile revival of the 1847 Pickering volume.

rougeux:2018.author: Nicholas Rougeux
rougeux:2018.work: Byrne's Euclid: The First Six Books of the Elements of Euclid with Coloured Diagrams and Symbols
rougeux:2018.note: Pioneering interactive digital edition pairing clickable inline glyphs with SVG diagrams and Caslon woodcut initials.

rougeux:2018-making.author: Nicholas Rougeux
rougeux:2018-making.note: Documents Rougeux's typographic workflow, SVG construction process, and correction of minor 1847 print errata.
